resale_co.name: Residential Resale Certificate (Certificate of Continued Occupancy)
resale_co.issued_by: Code Enforcement / Property Maintenance, 48 Washington Street
resale_co.lead_time: Close out open permits and get the County smoke/CO certificate first; the smoke certificate must be provided before or by the inspection date
requirements: Smoke/CO detector certificate from the fire prevention office provided before or by the inspection date
Electric, water and gas on; house numbers at least 4 inches with contrasting background
Metal dryer exhaust pipe with no screws; chimney certification for any fireplace or wood stove
Secure handrails and guards on stairs with 4 or more risers and landings over 30 inches; graspable handrail on one side
Steps, porches, sidewalks, curbs and aprons in safe condition; yard free of overgrowth
Interior clean (kitchen, cabinets, refrigerator, bath fixtures); stove anti-tip device; kitchen exhaust fan working
No plumbing leaks; sump pumps must not discharge into the sanitary sewer; water heater in good repair
Windows clean, uncracked, glazed, locking and operable with one hand, with screens; storm and screen doors with closers
Thumb-latch door locks only (no double-keyed deadbolts or hasps); privacy locks on bedrooms and bathrooms
No electrical hazards or extension cords as permanent wiring; covers on all switches and outlets; globes on light fixtures
Floor coverings secure and not worn; heating outlets and baseboard covers secured
Heating system safe and able to heat October 1 to May 1
Pools and pool barriers code compliant
Open Building/Construction permits inspected and closed; any work done without permits must be permitted and finaled before scheduling

Resale inspection, second inspection, per unit

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Borough's Application for Certificate of Continued Occupancy (check 'Resale', attach a property survey) and pay the non-refundable fee when you submit it, by check or money order payable to the Borough of South River (the older Residential Resale Certificate form also allows cash). Submit to Code Enforcement / Property Maintenance, 48 Washington Street, South River, NJ 08882.

evidence.quote: The Township of South River does require a Certificate of Occupancy (CO) for the resale of a property.
APPLICATION FOR CERTIFICATE OF CONTINUED OCCUPANCY
A CERTIFICATION OF CONTINUED OCCUPANCY NONREFUNDABLE FEE MUST BE PAID AT THE TIME OF APPLICATION SUBMITTAL.
A Certificate of Continued Occupancy is a prior approval and only after receiving one is occupancy permitted.
A smoke detector/carbon monoxide detector/ fire extinguisher certificate must be obtained from the Bureau of Fire Prevention. Smoke Certification must be provided before or by Inspection Date.
A RESIDENTIAL RESALE CERTIFICATE IS A PRIOR APPROVAL AND ONLY AFTER RECEIVING SUCH CERTIFICATE WILL OCCUPANCY BE PERMITTED.
THIS CERTIFICATE IS GOOD FOR 60 DAYS!
$100.00 per unit for 1st inspection resale $100.00 per unit for 2nd inspection resale $125.00 per unit for 3rd inspection resale
Carolyn LaBella Secretary - Zoning & Code Enforcement Email Carolyn LaBella Phone: 732-257-1999, ext. 503

resale_co.notes: The Borough's Forms & Permits page posts both a 'Residential Resale Certificate' packet (scanned, July 2024) and a newer 'Certificate of Continued Occupancy Application' (January 2026) that covers resale and rental; both list the same resale fees ($100 first, $100 second, $125 third inspection per unit). The 2026 form's fee table prints the $125 third-inspection resale line twice. The 2024 notice lists the contact phone as 732-257-1999 ext. 0; the 2026 form and the Code Enforcement page give ext. 503. No two-family specific fee: fees are per unit. Rentals also need this certificate (with different fees), which is not a resale item.

requirements: Smoke alarms on every level (basement, first floor, second floor; not crawl spaces or unfinished attics) and outside sleeping areas within 10 feet; basement alarm near the bottom of the stairs
Smoke alarms no older than 10 years (or the maker's expiration date); wall-mounted alarms 6 to 12 inches below the ceiling
CO alarm outside each separate sleeping area; the County sheet says CO alarms must not be older than 5 years or the maker's expiration date

Detector type by year built (County criteria sheet): before 1977 battery; 1977-1983 electric; 1984-1989 electric interconnected; 1990 and later electric with battery backup, all interconnected, including one in each bedroom
House numbers at least 4 inches high and visible from the street (2 inches on both sides of a curbside mailbox)

The County application and guideline sheet still list a fire extinguisher (2A:10B:C, 10 lb. or less, within 10 feet of the kitchen, top no more than 5 feet above the floor, tagged within 12 months or with a purchase receipt); P.L.2025, c.19 removed the state requirement, so confirm with the Fire Marshal
Certificate is issued right after the inspection and is valid for 6 months

authorities.how_to_apply: Complete the Middlesex County Fire Marshal's Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Detector Application (posted on the Borough's Forms & Permits page) and send it to the County Fire Marshal, 1001 Fire Academy Drive, Sayreville (firemarshal@co.middlesex.nj.us, 732-316-7171). Make checks payable to the Office of the Fire Marshal. The certificate is issued right after a passed inspection.

fire_cert.notes: The DCA July 2026 registry lists the County (code C) as South River's fire enforcing agency. The fee schedule and application come from the Middlesex County Fire Marshal's own letter and forms, posted on the Borough's Forms & Permits page (PDF created February 2, 2026; the County letter itself is undated; scanned, read visually). The County site itself returned 403 Forbidden to plain requests. The state directory page for South River is from a 2020 survey. The Borough's CCO checklist calls the issuing office the 'Bureau of Fire Prevention' and still says 'smoke detector/carbon monoxide detector/ fire extinguisher certificate'. The County letterhead gives Sayreville, NJ 08872 and the application page gives 08879. Type is 'unknown' because the schema has no county option.

other_items.label: Open permits and unpermitted work
